## FloatingPanel.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `open` :: Controls whether the panel is mounted/visible; bindable.
- `onOpenChange` :: Called when open state changes (for example via the close button or Escape).
- `title` :: Title shown in the draggable header bar.
- `x` :: Horizontal viewport offset in pixels; bindable.
- `y` :: Vertical viewport offset in pixels; bindable.
- `width` :: CSS panel width (for example `'22rem'`).
- `minimized` :: Collapses the body and footer while keeping the header bar visible; bindable.
- `pinnable` :: Shows a pin button that locks panel dragging.
- `pinned` :: Prevents dragging when `true`; bindable.
- `closable` :: Shows a close button in the header.
- `pinButtonProps` :: Props forwarded to the pin IconButton, so a caller can change its size, variant or ink.
- `minimizeButtonProps` :: Props forwarded to the minimize IconButton in the header.
- `closeButtonProps` :: Props forwarded to the close IconButton in the header.
- `surface` :: Surface styling on the shared surface axis.
- `shape` :: Corner family of the panel's outer edge, `rect` through `round`; it defaults to `curved`.
- `textSize` :: Text scale of the title in the header.
- `children` :: Panel body content.
- `headerActions` :: Extra controls rendered beside the window buttons in the header.
- `footer` :: Optional panel footer action row.
